name: SmolLM2-135M-Instruct
description: Compact instruction-tuned language model for general text generation.
avoidWhen: Avoid for high-stakes reasoning, broad factual knowledge, or tasks requiring large context.
whenToUse: Use for short general-purpose text generation when a local model is preferred.

name: Needle 3
description: Tiny structured inference model for tool selection, argument extraction, classification, and embeddings.
avoidWhen: Avoid for open-ended long-form generation or complex multi-step reasoning.
whenToUse: Use when natural language must be mapped to a small tool set or structured schema.
input: Natural-language text with optional tools or extraction schema

name: Whistle

avoidWhen: Avoid when audio understanding beyond transcription is required.
whenToUse: Use for local speech-to-text when low resource use and privacy matter.
